headline: 1 token address catalogued (SIUSD on Ethereum); deployment artifacts, audit PDFs, and Etherscan name-tag search inaccessible this run.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan searchHandler endpoint rejected (not in prior search/fetch allowlist); no name-tag results retrieved for 'infinifi' on etherscan.io. One address (0xDBDC1Ef57537E34680B898E1FEBD3D68c7389bCB, SIUSD) surfaced via web_search hitting ethplorer.io.

D2: Protocol website (https://infinifi.xyz) returned a network error on fetch; deployed contracts doc not located. Docs URL https://infinifilabs.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/InfiniFi/pages/207814657/Architecture surfaced from GitHub README but not fetched this run.

D3: Three audit links provided (docsend.com). All require browser JS rendering; direct fetch not attempted due to allowlist restrictions and limited remaining fetch calls. No in-scope contract addresses extracted.

D4: GitHub repo InfiniFi-Labs/infinifi-protocol fetched. Repo has a deployment/configuration directory and a script directory but GitHub tree fetch for subdirectories was rejected (permission denied). No broadcast run-latest.json or addresses.json visible from top-level listing. No deployed addresses found in README.
D5: Protocol.chains = Ethereum only; single-chain enumeration applies. No multi-chain deployments to enumerate.
D6: No factory addresses were discovered this run, so factory-child enumeration was not possible.
D7: One address classified: 0xDBDC1Ef57537E34680B898E1FEBD3D68c7389bCB as token (SIUSD receipt token). Role taxonomy applied: token. actor_class unknown (bytecode not read).

D8: Only SIUSD address traces to a fetched URL (ethplorer.io search result snippet). All other contract addresses (iUSD token, InfiniFiCore, Gateway, MintController, RedeemController, LockingController, multisig/timelock) not found in any fetched source this run.

rationale.verdict: Discovery is severely incomplete: the protocol website was inaccessible, GitHub subdirectory access was blocked, audit PDFs on docsend.com were not fetched, and Etherscan name-tag search was unavailable from the allowlist. Only one token address (SIUSD) was surfaced from a search snippet. Grade is unknown pending a run with access to the deployed contracts doc, Etherscan label search, and at least one audit PDF scope table.

protocol_metadata.about: InfiniFi is a DeFi yield protocol on Ethereum that lets users mint iUSD receipt tokens by depositing USDC collateral, then optionally stake (siUSD) for passive yield or lock (liUSD) for enhanced returns. The protocol deploys deposited capital across liquid farms (Aave, Morpho) and illiquid duration farms (Pendle, Ethena) in a fractional-reserve model, matching deposit lock-up preferences to appropriate yield strategies. Farm allocation is governed by token-weighted voting from locked-position holders, and redemptions are processed via a queue that clears instantly when sufficient liquidity exists.
